diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index a2c7a7d..3dd53d0 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -3,3 +3,5 @@
 A tiny package that builds a greeting.
 
     python3 -c "from greet.core import build_greeting; print(build_greeting('Ada'))"
+
+`build_greeting` automatically capitalises names regardless of how they were originally typed, so `ada`, `ADA` and `Ada` all produce the same greeting.

diff --git a/greet/core.py b/greet/core.py
index 503aa34..5f32cd5 100644
--- a/greet/core.py
+++ b/greet/core.py
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 
 def build_greeting(name: str) -> str:
     """Return the greeting for NAME."""
-    return f"Hallo, {name.strip()}!"
+    return f"Hallo, {name.strip().title()}!"

diff --git a/tests/test_greet.py b/tests/test_greet.py
index 1766d41..33c25e0 100644
--- a/tests/test_greet.py
+++ b/tests/test_greet.py
@@ -10,6 +10,30 @@ def test_greeting_trims_spaces():
     assert build_greeting("  Ada ") == "Hallo, Ada!"
 
 
+def test_greeting_capitalises_lowercase_name():
+    assert build_greeting("john") == "Hallo, John!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_normalises_all_caps_name():
+    assert build_greeting("JOHN DOE") == "Hallo, John Doe!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_normalises_all_caps_single_word_name():
+    assert build_greeting("JOHN") == "Hallo, John!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_capitalises_lowercase_multi_word_name():
+    assert build_greeting("john doe") == "Hallo, John Doe!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_normalises_mixed_case_single_word_name():
+    assert build_greeting("jOhN") == "Hallo, John!"
+
+
+def test_greeting_normalises_mixed_case_multi_word_name():
+    assert build_greeting("jOHN dOE") == "Hallo, John Doe!"
+
+
 def test_cli_prints_the_greeting(capsys):
     assert main(["Ada"]) == 0
     assert capsys.readouterr().out == "Hallo, Ada!\n"
